description: This file defines the AdbDevice class, representing a USB device that supports the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) protocol. It manages USB endpoints, socket communication, request pools, connection handling, and message dispatching to facilitate ADB communication over USB.

classes.name: AdbDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device capable of ADB communication, handling endpoints, sockets, request pools, and message dispatching.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the USB device.

methods.name: getOutRequest
methods.description: Provides an UsbRequest object for sending data out through the device, utilizing a request pool.

methods.name: releaseOutRequest
methods.description: Returns an UsbRequest object back to the out request pool.

methods.name: getInRequest
methods.description: Provides an UsbRequest object for receiving data from the device, utilizing a request pool.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the waiter thread to handle incoming messages and initiates the connection process.

methods.name: openSocket
methods.description: Opens a new AdbSocket for communication with a specified destination.

methods.name: getSocket
methods.description: Retrieves an existing socket by its ID.

methods.name: socketClosed
methods.description: Removes a socket from the active sockets list when it is closed.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Sends a connection request to the device.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Handles the response to a connection request, confirming device connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the waiter thread to stop running.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming ADB messages to the appropriate socket handlers based on message command type.
